changes.comment: Add an optional `pk` argument to @entity, declaring a composite primary key over `id` plus additional non-nullable scalar or enum columns. Absent or ["id"] keeps the existing single-column key

Generate a `<entity>ByPks` query taking one argument per primary key column. `<entity>ById` remains available and unchanged for entities with a single-column key; entities with a composite key expose ByPks only, since `id` alone does not identify a row there
